_about: One real photo or classical painting per scene (lib/scene-photos.ts). `file` is a Wikimedia Commons file title; scripts/build-scene-photos.mjs downloads it, checks the licence, crops and compresses it into app/styles/photos/. Entries with file null keep their drawn painting. `trim` (optional) cuts a mount, frame or caption off the original before it is compressed: percent off the top, right, bottom and left. `focus` is the CSS object-position to keep in frame; `fx` is the light moving over it: embers, mist, glints, dust, stars or none. `queries` are the Commons searches scripts/find-scene-photos.mjs runs to propose candidates.
